nodes.label: Clean Architecture + MVI/MVVM (Unidirectional Data Flow)
nodes.rationale: Domain/Data/Presentation layering with ViewModels exposing StateFlow was chosen for separation of concerns and unidirectional data flow across the app.

nodes.label: Duty Switch Privacy Guarantee
nodes.rationale: Off-duty must guarantee complete location privacy: stopping the foreground service kills GPS writes entirely; no coordinates are ever written when off-duty.

nodes.label: Institutional Domain Lock (@vitstudent.ac.in)
nodes.rationale: STUDENT role requires email ending with @vitstudent.ac.in (rejected otherwise with DomainRestrictionException); DRIVER accepts any email. Enforces the campus-only user base at sign-in time.
